name: Jahdiel
overview: Jahdiel was a male figure from the tribe of Manasseh, known specifically as a head of households within this tribe. His role as a leader among the Manassites indicates a position of responsibility and authority within his community, as noted in 1 Chronicles 5:24. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Jahdiel means 'G-d [El] gives joy,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning rooted in the Hebrew understanding of God's character. This proper name is noted in 1 Chronicles 5:24 and highlights the joy that comes from God, though it was not indicated to be given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Jahdiel as a descendant of Manasseh, linking him to this prominent tribal lineage. Beyond this, no further family relationships are recorded in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jahdiel's significance lies in his leadership role as a head of households within the tribe of Manasseh. This position underscores the organizational and familial structures present among the tribes of Israel during the period recorded in 1 Chronicles. His mention affirms the continuity of tribal governance and the importance of household heads in maintaining the social and religious order of God's people.
